component.name: Git Subtree Report
component.summary: Analyze Git repositories without checking out files

description.p: Git Subtree Report is a powerful, zero-footprint analysis tool for developers, auditors, and CI/CD systems. It operates with the precision of a master historian, reading the soul of a Git repository directly from its object database without disturbing the filesystem.
This allows you to safely and efficiently inspect any commit, branch, or tag—even in multi-gigabyte repositories—to understand its structure and content.

ul.li: Visualize the full file tree of any repository subtree.
Use a powerful two-stage filtering system to include or exclude files.
Perform deep content analysis to detect binary data, invalid UTF-8, and other non-textual elements.
Identify special files like submodules, symbolic links, and Git LFS pointers.
Generate a clean, safe concatenation of all text-based files for review or processing.
Operate in a pure read-only mode, making it perfect for security-sensitive environments.

description.p: This release introduces a powerful two-stage filtering system and enhances report clarity.

ul.li: New `--include` flag for creating an initial 'allow-list' of files.
New `NAME-BASED FILTERING REPORT` section explicitly details which files were selected or rejected.
Hardened concatenation safety to prevent special file types (symlinks, etc.) from being included.

description.p: Major command-line interface overhaul for improved usability and scripting.

ul.li: Added support for long options (e.g., `--exclude`) and assignment-style options (`--ref=main`).

description.p: Introduced desktop integration and standardized project structure for better system compatibility.

ul.li: Added AppStream metadata and a .desktop file for Linux software centers.
Moved executable to `bin/` and added versioned suffix (`-1`) to the installed command.
Corrected documentation to specify Extended Regular Expressions (ERE) for filters.

description.p: New centralized error handling system for more user-friendly and consistent error messages.
Security hardening release: hardened the script against TOCTOU race conditions by validating the `-C` path for symbolic links.
Enhanced report output with more statistics and transparency.
Significant performance refactor by changing the core analysis from 'path-centric' to 'blob-centric' to avoid re-analyzing duplicate files.
Added a comprehensive `man(1)` page for integrated, offline help.
Added a `meson.build` file for standardized installation.

ul.li: Concatenation safety checks and output mode.
